rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for an item kept or given to remember an event or place.

example.english: This souvenir is something I received on my graduation day.
example.traditional: 呢件紀念品係我喺畢業禮嗰日收到嘅。
example.jyutping: ni1 gin6 gei2 nim6 ban2 hai6 ngo5 hai2 bat1 jip6 lai5 go2 jat6 sau1 dou3 ge3

rows.note: Use this specifically for a gift or local product brought back from a trip or place, rather than any commemorative keepsake.

example.english: I brought back a souvenir from Taiwan—some pineapple cakes.
example.traditional: 我去台灣旅行，特登買咗啲鳳梨酥做手信。
example.jyutping: ngo5 heoi3 toi4 waan1 leoi5 hang4 dak6 dang1 maai5 zo2 di1 fung6 lei4 sou1 zou6 sau2 seon3
